title: Portal Reframed for System Modeling & Simulation
content: The portal now follows the curriculum chronologically and includes week-linked solved problems, trace tables, and simulation demos.

title: New Applications Tab (RNG First)
content: A dedicated Applications tab has been added. It starts with random-number generation methods then extends to queue, inventory, repairman, and assembly-line applications.

title: AI Tutor Updated for Simulation Curriculum
content: AI tutor prompts were rewritten for simulation topics and step-by-step problem guidance. Set VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY to enable live model responses.
